statement: The external model providers that may process client material, for the engineering side of the MSA provider schedule. The MSA's own schedule is an agreement held outside this public repository; this file names the same provider so the receiver can refuse any other. Being named here is one of three conditions. A separately signed per-client opt-in is still required for every client; the switch is off until it is recorded.
owner_direction: Owner direction, 26 September 2026: name Chutes as the external model provider for client intake; keep the guard against automatic transfer; make it a per-client switch that defaults off; route no client content through it; prove the path with synthetic material only. The owner lifted the synthetic-only restriction later the same day: a real client's record may be sent once that client's signed opt-in is recorded.

conditions.basis: Owner determination: confidential-compute (TEE) execution, and an API that cannot decrypt the request. Recorded as the owner's determination, not as an engineering verification of the provider's terms.

models.chosen_for: Context length: client design briefs are long documents. The TEE premium over non-confidential inference is deliberate.
